---
name: agx
description: Use when running, resuming or switching Claude Code / Codex / Gemini CLI / pi sessions and accounts with agx: profiles and homes, named logins, login pools that switch Claude accounts by usage, live login, plan usage, conversations, folder bindings, shell aliases, and agx's own config.
---

# agx

Generated by `agx skill` from agx v0.0.0-test. Regenerate it after upgrading agx: `agx skill --install`.

## How agx works

agx is one CLI for AI coding agents (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI, pi and config-defined agents) across every account on the machine. Its config is `~/.agx/config.jsonc` (JSONC, checked strictly: an unknown key or a wrong type is an error at its line).

- **Profiles** name an agent home (`~/.claude-work`) plus launch defaults: `agx run --profile work`.
- **Logins** run any home on any account: a plan token or API key from a reference (`${gopass:…}`, `$(…)`, `${VAR}`), a pasted value in `tokens.jsonc` (0600), or a key helper. `agx run --login carol`. agx never prints a token, except `agx login token` on request (to a pipe, or with `--reveal`).
- **Login pools** (Claude Code only): a login of kind `pool` lists your own logins and teammates' shared ones; `agx run --login auto` is a live run in which each key request picks a member by usage (soonest weekly reset first, own accounts almost fully, shared ones up to their caps). `agx pool pick --id auto` shows the pick and why, `agx pool list` and `agx pool show --id auto` the pools and their settings (create and change one with `agx login add --kind pool` and `agx login edit --pool-…`); `--pool-force NAME` forces one member, ignoring its caps; `--pool-only NAME` (on run, new, resume, `pool pick`, `login token` and `live use`) keeps a run on one member with its caps enforced, so it gets no key while that member is over a cap (`--pool-only-short N` / `--pool-only-week N` lower the caps for that run only); `agx live use --id RUN --login NAME` pins a running session and `--login auto` unpins it.
- **Live login**: `--live-login` makes a Claude session's login switchable while it runs (`agx live use`).
- **Which account a session is on**: run `! agx whoami` inside Claude (`in use:`, `next:`); Claude's /status only says apiKeyHelper.
- **Resolution chain**: agent, profile, home, login, binary, folder and args are each decided by the first source that sets them: flags, then `AGX_LOGIN`/`AGX_LOGIN_<AGENT>`, a folder binding (`agx project use`), the profile, the agent defaults, the default profile. `--dry-run` on `run`/`new`/`resume` prints every decision with its source and starts nothing: use it before launching.
- **Scripting**: `--json` prints one envelope (`ok`, `data`, `decisions`, `warnings`, `error`); `--field data.PATH` prints one value; `--quiet` drops notes. `agx help --json` prints the command tree.
- **Exit codes**: 0 ok, 1 failure, 2 usage error (a bad flag or value), 3 partial (some rows failed), 4 unsupported by the agent; launching commands use 125 for agx's own errors, 126 and 127 for the agent binary.
- **Cost**: some commands spend quota (login probes: `agx login check`, `agx usage --all-logins`, `agx pool pick` on a stale cache) or hit the network (`agx usage`); prefer `--cached`, `--no-probe`, `--dry-run` when you only need to look.

## Global flags

Every command takes these.

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--color VALUE` | colour: auto (each stream that is a terminal, unless NO_COLOR is set), always or never; tables, usage bars and agx's error and warning lines (default auto) |
| `--config VALUE` | config file (default: $AGX_CONFIG_DIR, else $AGX_HOME, else ~/.agx)/config.jsonc |
| `--date-format VALUE` | how dates and times read: tokens such as "ddd D MMM HH:mm" or a preset (iso, short, long, us); default: config usage.date_format (agx usage), else date_format, else long for usage and iso elsewhere |
| `--field VALUE` | keep only this path of the envelope (repeat); picks table columns with data.*.KEY (repeatable) |
| `--json` | print the JSON envelope |
| `--quiet` | no stderr notes |
| `--timeout DURATION` | per-request network timeout (default 15s) |

## Commands

Every command takes named flags only; a bare `agx` or a bare group prints help.

### agx agent

Known agents and their capabilities.

### agx agent list

Known agents: kind, binary, version, tested range, capabilities.

Every agent agx knows: the agentio built-ins and the agents defined in config. The version comes from install metadata; the binary is never run. Capabilities are agentio's, generated, never a hand table.

### agx agent show

One agent with each capability and the reason when missing.

```sh
agx agent show --id codex
agx agent show --id claude --vendor-checks
```

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--id VALUE` | the agent id (agx agent list) |
| `--vendor-checks` | also run the binary's --version (cost X) |

### agx alias

Shell aliases generated by shell-init.

### agx alias add

Add or replace an alias.

```sh
agx alias add --name cl --args "run --profile personal"
agx alias add --name clr --args resume
```

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--args VALUE` | the agx arguments it runs, named flags only ("run --profile work") |
| `--name VALUE` | the alias name |

### agx alias list

Shell aliases.

### agx alias remove

Remove an alias.

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--id VALUE` | the alias name |

### agx clean

Delete run folders whose agent has ended.

```sh
agx clean            # the plan
agx clean --yes      # delete ended runs
```

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | show the plan; delete nothing |
| `--yes` | delete the ended runs (without it: the plan only) |

### agx completion

Print a completion script.

```sh
source <(agx completion --shell bash)
agx completion --shell zsh > "${fpath[1]}/_agx"
agx completion --shell fish | source
```

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--shell VALUE` | the shell: zsh, bash, fish, pwsh |

### agx config

agx's own config file.

### agx config check

Load, validate and cross-check the config; lists every problem.

### agx config init

Write a commented starter config.jsonc.

```sh
agx config init --default-agent claude --discovered
agx config init --dry-run
```

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--default-agent VALUE` | write default_agent (at a terminal without it: asked) |
| `--discovered` | add every discovered home as a profile (at a terminal without it: offered) |
| `--dry-run` | print the file; write nothing |

### agx config path

The config file path.

### agx config set

Set a scalar key, keeping comments.

```sh
agx config set --key default_agent --value claude
agx config set --key sessions.root --value ~/sessions
agx config set --key profiles.work.model --value opus
```

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--key VALUE` | a dotted scalar key (default_agent, sessions.root, profiles.NAME.model, …) |
| `--value VALUE` | the value (true/false for switches, digits for numbers) |

### agx config show

The resolved config and each value's source.

### agx conversation

Conversations stored in agent homes.

### agx conversation list

Print conversations, newest first (this folder unless --scope all).

```sh
agx conversation list
agx conversation list --scope all --query pglite
agx conversation list --scope all --by-folder --agent claude
```

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--agent VALUE` | only this agent's homes |
| `--by-folder` | one row per folder |
| `--limit N` | conversations considered, newest first (0 = all) (default 50) |
| `--profile VALUE` | only these profiles' homes (repeat) (repeatable) |
| `--query VALUE` | keep conversations whose title, folder or id holds this text |
| `--scope VALUE` | folder (the current folder) or all (default folder) |

### agx conversation move

Move a folder's conversations to another home of the same agent.

Move a folder's conversations from one home to another home of the same agent, so they resume there. Only agents whose history can move (agentio ConversationMover; Claude today) are supported; others are refused with the agent's reason (exit 4). A running conversation, or an id already in the target, stops the move before any file changes. agentio backs every file up first; --no-backup discards that copy after a successful move.

```sh
agx conversation move --to-profile work --dry-run
agx conversation move --to-profile work --from-profile personal --id 3f2a
agx conversation move --to-profile work --picker chat
```

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--dir VALUE` | the folder whose conversations move (default: the current folder) |
| `--dry-run` | print the plan; change nothing |
| `--from-profile VALUE` | the profile whose home holds them (default: the one other home with history here) |
| `--id VALUE` | only this conversation, exact or a unique prefix (repeat) (repeatable) |
| `--no-backup` | discard the backup after a successful move |
| `--picker VALUE` | chat (tick conversations) or folder (choose a folder, then tick); needs a terminal |
| `--scope VALUE` | folder (the current folder) or all (every folder of the source home) (default folder) |
| `--to-profile VALUE` | the profile whose home receives them (required) |

### agx conversation show

One conversation: home, folder, title, turns, size, last activity, live.

```sh
agx conversation show --id 3f2a
```

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--id VALUE` | the conversation, exact or a unique prefix |

### agx doctor

Local checks: config, references, binaries, homes, run folders.

Checks this machine without the network, without resolving a secret and without running a vendor binary: config, references (parse, scheme plugin, program on PATH), tokens.jsonc mode, ended run folders (reported, never deleted), the shell layer, each agent's binary and version, and agentio's checks of every configured home. Plain token values in config are listed by key. Exits 1 when a check fails.

```sh
agx doctor
agx doctor --agent codex
agx doctor --resolved-secrets --vendor-checks
```

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--agent VALUE` | check only this agent's binary and homes |
| `--resolved-secrets` | also resolve every reference (cost X); values are never shown |
| `--vendor-checks` | also run each binary's --version (cost X) |

### agx help

Help; --json prints the command tree.

### agx live

Running sessions started with --live-login.

### agx live list

Running sessions started with --live-login.

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--agent VALUE` | only this agent's runs |

### agx live show

One run's live state.

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--id VALUE` | the run id |

### agx live use

Choose the login of a live run.

```sh
agx live use --id 20261114-101500-k3x9 --login alice
agx live use --id 20261114-101500-k3x9 --start-login
agx live use --id 20261114-101500-k3x9 --pool-only alice
agx live use --id 20261114-101500-k3x9 --login auto
```

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--id VALUE` | the run id |
| `--login VALUE` | the login the agent gets at its next refresh |
| `--pool-only VALUE` | pin a pool run to this member with its caps enforced (--login clears it) |
| `--pool-only-short VALUE` | with --pool-only: a lower 5-hour cap for that member, for this run (never above its own) |
| `--pool-only-week VALUE` | with --pool-only: a lower weekly cap for that member, for this run (never above its own) |
| `--start-login` | back to the login the run started with |

### agx login

Logins: what a launch authenticates with.

### agx login add

Add a login.

```sh
agx login add --name personal --agent claude --kind oauth-token --token-ref '${gopass:personal/claude-token}'
pbpaste | agx login add --name pasted --agent claude --kind oauth-token --stdin
agx login add --name carol --agent claude --kind oauth-token --login-setup
agx login add --name auto --agent claude --kind pool --pool-own alice --pool-own bob --pool-shared carol
agx login add --name auto --agent claude --kind pool --pool-own alice --pool-shared carol --pool-cap-short alice=95 --pool-cap-week alice=98 --dry-run
```

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--account VALUE` | a display label, such as the account email |
| `--agent VALUE` | an agent it serves (repeat) (repeatable) |
| `--dry-run` | show the pool's keys; write nothing (--kind pool) |
| `--helper-command VALUE` | an api-key-helper command the agent runs itself |
| `--kind VALUE` | oauth-token, api-key, api-key-helper or pool (default: the first agent's default kind) |
| `--login-setup` | run the first agent's token setup command (claude setup-token; cost X), then paste the token |
| `--name VALUE` | the new login's name |
| `--pool-borrow-window VALUE` | a shared member goes first when its weekly reset is this close, like 48h (empty: default 48h) |
| `--pool-cap-short VALUE` | a member's own 5-hour cap: NAME=PERCENT; NAME= removes it (repeat) (repeatable) |
| `--pool-cap-week VALUE` | a member's own weekly cap: NAME=PERCENT; NAME= removes it (repeat) (repeatable) |
| `--pool-default-short VALUE` | the 5-hour cap of members without their own, in percent (empty: default 50) |
| `--pool-default-week VALUE` | the weekly cap of members without their own, in percent (empty: default 70) |
| `--pool-disable VALUE` | leave a member out of the pool: enabled false (repeat) (repeatable) |
| `--pool-enable VALUE` | take a disabled member back (repeat) (repeatable) |
| `--pool-key-ttl VALUE` | how long the agent keeps a key before it asks again, like 60s (empty: default 60s) |
| `--pool-own VALUE` | a pool member that is your own account, used up almost fully (repeat; --kind pool) (repeatable) |
| `--pool-picker VALUE` | a shell command that picks the member instead of the built-in rules (empty removes it) |
| `--pool-shared VALUE` | a pool member that is a teammate's account, borrowed up to its caps (repeat; --kind pool) (repeatable) |
| `--pool-short-cutoff VALUE` | the 5-hour safety cutoff for every member, in percent (empty: default 99) |
| `--pool-usage-max-age VALUE` | how old the usage cache may be before members are probed again, like 60s (empty: default 60s) |
| `--provider VALUE` | the model provider, for agents with a key per provider (pi) |
| `--stdin` | read the value from stdin (stored in tokens.jsonc, 0600) |
| `--token-ref VALUE` | a reference (${gopass:…}, $(…), ${VAR}) or a plain value, written to config |

### agx login check

Resolve logins and probe them (spends a few tokens unless --no-probe).

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--id VALUE` | a login to check (repeat; default: every login) (repeatable) |
| `--no-probe` | resolve only; never spend quota |

### agx login edit

Rotate or change a login.

```sh
pbpaste | agx login edit --id pasted --stdin
agx login edit --id personal --account me@example.com
agx login edit --id auto --pool-force alice
agx login edit --id auto --pool-force ''
agx login edit --id auto --pool-cap-short alice=95 --pool-cap-week alice=98 --pool-disable carol --dry-run
```

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--account VALUE` | set the display label (empty clears it) |
| `--agent VALUE` | replace the agents it serves (repeat) (repeatable) |
| `--dry-run` | show a pool's changes; write nothing |
| `--helper-command VALUE` | an api-key-helper command the agent runs itself |
| `--id VALUE` | the login to change |
| `--kind VALUE` | change the kind |
| `--login-setup` | run the first agent's token setup command (claude setup-token; cost X), then paste the token |
| `--pool-borrow-window VALUE` | a shared member goes first when its weekly reset is this close, like 48h (empty: default 48h) |
| `--pool-cap-short VALUE` | a member's own 5-hour cap: NAME=PERCENT; NAME= removes it (repeat) (repeatable) |
| `--pool-cap-week VALUE` | a member's own weekly cap: NAME=PERCENT; NAME= removes it (repeat) (repeatable) |
| `--pool-default-short VALUE` | the 5-hour cap of members without their own, in percent (empty: default 50) |
| `--pool-default-week VALUE` | the weekly cap of members without their own, in percent (empty: default 70) |
| `--pool-disable VALUE` | leave a member out of the pool: enabled false (repeat) (repeatable) |
| `--pool-enable VALUE` | take a disabled member back (repeat) (repeatable) |
| `--pool-force VALUE` | make a pool always pick this member (empty clears it) |
| `--pool-key-ttl VALUE` | how long the agent keeps a key before it asks again, like 60s (empty: default 60s) |
| `--pool-own VALUE` | replace a pool's own members (repeat) (repeatable) |
| `--pool-picker VALUE` | a shell command that picks the member instead of the built-in rules (empty removes it) |
| `--pool-shared VALUE` | replace a pool's shared members (repeat) (repeatable) |
| `--pool-short-cutoff VALUE` | the 5-hour safety cutoff for every member, in percent (empty: default 99) |
| `--pool-usage-max-age VALUE` | how old the usage cache may be before members are probed again, like 60s (empty: default 60s) |
| `--provider VALUE` | set the model provider (empty clears it) |
| `--stdin` | read the value from stdin (stored in tokens.jsonc, 0600) |
| `--token-ref VALUE` | a reference (${gopass:…}, $(…), ${VAR}) or a plain value, written to config |

### agx login list

Every login, never a value.

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--agent VALUE` | only logins serving this agent |

### agx login remove

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--cascade` | also clear it from profiles, agent defaults and bindings |
| `--id VALUE` | the login to remove |

### agx login show

One login: kind, source, account, agents and what uses it.

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--agent VALUE` | the agent it must serve; narrows the users to it |
| `--id VALUE` | the login name |

### agx login token

Print one login's token for a pipe or an apiKeyHelper (a terminal needs --reveal).

Resolve a login's token from its source (a stored value, ${gopass:…}, $(…), ${VAR} or a plain value) and print only the value and a newline on stdout. It reads what is stored or referenced and never refreshes a token; a $(…) or gopass reference runs that local command. Stdout must be a pipe or a file unless --reveal is given. An api-key-helper login has no token and is refused. Every error is one line on stderr, without hint lines, and stdout stays empty.

```sh
agx login token --id work-key | pbcopy
agx login add --name console --agent claude --kind api-key-helper --helper-command 'agx login token --id work-key'
```

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--id VALUE` | the login name |
| `--pool-force VALUE` | on a pool login: print this member's token, over the pool's rules |
| `--pool-only VALUE` | on a pool login: print this member's token while its caps allow, else none (never another member) |
| `--pool-only-short VALUE` | with --pool-only: a lower 5-hour cap for that member, for this call (never above its own) |
| `--pool-only-week VALUE` | with --pool-only: a lower weekly cap for that member, for this call (never above its own) |
| `--reveal` | print the token even when stdout is a terminal |

### agx login use

Set the login of a profile, an agent or this terminal.

Set the default login of a profile (--profile) or an agent (--agent), or print the line that sets this terminal's AGX_LOGIN (--terminal; the shell layer evaluates it, otherwise copy it).

```sh
agx login use --id personal --profile work
agx login use --home-login --profile work
agx login use --id personal --agent claude
agx login use --id derek --terminal
```

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--agent VALUE` | set it as this agent's default login |
| `--home-login` | the home's own login instead of a named one |
| `--id VALUE` | the login |
| `--profile VALUE` | set it as this profile's login |
| `--terminal` | print the AGX_LOGIN line for this terminal; writes nothing |

### agx new

Create a timestamped session folder and start an agent in it.

```sh
agx new --name "pglite golang" --profile work
```

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--add-dir VALUE` | extra folder the agent may access (repeat) (repeatable) |
| `--agent VALUE` | agent for the default or auto profile |
| `--auto-login` | pick the stored login with the most headroom (probes, cost Q) |
| `--auto-profile` | pick the profile with the most headroom (cost N) |
| `--autonomy VALUE` | default, read-only, ask, accept-edits or full |
| `--before-run VALUE` | a script to run first, for this run (relative to the current folder) |
| `--consent VALUE` | full-autonomy: allow --autonomy full |
| `--dry-run` | print every decision with its source; start nothing |
| `--env VALUE` | environment NAME=value; references expand strictly (repeat) (repeatable) |
| `--env-file VALUE` | a dotenv file, relative to the current folder (repeat) (repeatable) |
| `--headless` | machine-readable event stream |
| `--home-login` | the home's own login |
| `--live-login` | switch this session's login while it runs (agx live use) |
| `--login VALUE` | a login name |
| `--model VALUE` | model |
| `--name VALUE` | slug words for the folder name |
| `--no-env VALUE` | remove this variable (repeat) (repeatable) |
| `--option VALUE` | typed agent launch option key=value (repeat) (repeatable) |
| `--pool-force VALUE` | on a pool login: every key of this run comes from this member, over the pool's rules |
| `--pool-only VALUE` | on a pool login: every key of this run comes from this member while its caps allow, else no key (never another member) |
| `--pool-only-short VALUE` | with --pool-only: a lower 5-hour cap for that member, for this run (never above its own) |
| `--pool-only-week VALUE` | with --pool-only: a lower weekly cap for that member, for this run (never above its own) |
| `--profile VALUE`, `-p` | the profile |
| `--prompt VALUE` | initial prompt |
| `--resolved-secrets` | with --dry-run: resolve references (cost X) and say resolved or why not |
| `--setting VALUE` | agent settings key=value; dotted keys nest (repeat) (repeatable) |
| `--settings-delivery VALUE` | file (default) or inline |
| `--token-kind VALUE` | kind of --token-ref: oauth-token, api-key or api-key-helper (default oauth-token) |
| `--token-ref VALUE` | a one-off token: a reference (${gopass:…}, $(…), ${VAR}) or a plain value |

### agx pool

Login pools: list them, show their settings, see which member they pick.

### agx pool list

Every pool login: agents, own and shared members, force and picker.

List every login of kind pool from config, in the file's order: the agents it serves, its own and shared members, the member it always picks (force) and its picker command. It reads config only: no probe, no cache. A pool is a login of kind pool: create it with agx login add --kind pool, change it with agx login edit --pool-…, and run on it with agx run --login POOL.

```sh
agx pool list
agx pool list --json
```

### agx pool pick

Show which member a pool login picks now, and why (probes members whose cached usage is old).

Read the usage of a pool login's members (a probe each, spending a few tokens, unless the login-usage cache is younger than the pool's usage_max_age), decide as a key request would (--pool-force, the pool's force, its picker command, else the built-in rules) and print the member it picks, why, where the usage came from, then every member: #N READY in pick order, WAIT (usable, held back by the borrow window) or skip with every reason. Reset times follow --time-format, --duration-format, --tz and --date-format, as in agx usage. Exit 0 when a member is picked; exit 1 (error code auto-pick) when none is usable. It never prints a token: agx login token --id POOL prints the picked member's. A pool is a login of kind pool: create it with agx login add --kind pool, change it with agx login edit --pool-…, and run on it with agx run --login POOL.

```sh
agx pool pick --id auto
agx pool pick --id auto --cached
agx pool pick --id auto --pool-force alice
agx pool pick --id auto --time-format both
agx pool pick --id auto --json --field data.selected.name
```

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--cached` | use the login-usage cache only, of any age; probe nothing |
| `--duration-format VALUE` | how a reset a day or more away reads: truncate, round, minutes (default: config usage.duration_format, else truncate) |
| `--id VALUE` | the pool login |
| `--max-age DURATION` | reuse cached usage younger than this; 0 probes every member (default: the pool's usage_max_age) (default 0s) |
| `--pool-force VALUE` | pick this member for this one run, over the pool's rules, force and picker |
| `--pool-only VALUE` | pick only this member, with its caps enforced; none when it is blocked |
| `--pool-only-short VALUE` | with --pool-only: a lower 5-hour cap for that member, for this pick (never above its own) |
| `--pool-only-week VALUE` | with --pool-only: a lower weekly cap for that member, for this pick (never above its own) |
| `--time-format VALUE` | how reset times read: relative, day, absolute, both (default: config usage.time_format, else relative) |
| `--tz VALUE` | IANA zone for reset days and dates (default: this machine's) |

### agx pool show

One pool's settings, each with where it comes from (config or default).

Show one pool login's full settings: its agents, own and shared members with each member's caps and enabled state, then force, defaults, the shared borrow window, the 5-hour cutoff, usage_max_age, key_ttl, the picker and the log. Each value says where it comes from: config (the pool's block sets it), defaults (a member cap from the pool's defaults key) or default (agx's default for an omitted key). It reads config only: no probe, no cache. A pool is a login of kind pool: create it with agx login add --kind pool, change it with agx login edit --pool-…, and run on it with agx run --login POOL.

```sh
agx pool show --id auto
agx pool show --id auto --json --field data.settings
```

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--id VALUE` | the pool login |

### agx profile

Profiles: a name for one home plus launch defaults.

### agx profile add

Create a profile for a home; links the default home's shared files unless --bare.

```sh
agx profile add --name work --agent claude
agx profile add --name kimi --agent claude --home ~/.claude --billing api
agx profile add --name work --agent claude --dry-run
```

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--agent VALUE` | the agent |
| `--bare` | do not link the default home's shared files |
| `--billing VALUE` | plan (default) or api |
| `--dry-run` | show the entry and the shared files it would link; write nothing |
| `--home VALUE` | the home folder (default: the agent's default home plus -NAME, such as ~/.claude-work) |
| `--home-login` | use the home's own login (also over an agent default login) |
| `--login VALUE` | the profile's login |
| `--login-setup` | run the agent's token setup command in the new home, then store the pasted token as login NAME (cost X; terminal) |
| `--name VALUE` | the new profile's name |

### agx profile edit

Change a profile's login, home, args, env or billing.

```sh
agx profile edit --id work --login carol
agx profile edit --id kimi --no-inherit-defaults --args --dangerously-skip-permissions
agx profile edit --id work --env DEBUG=1 --dry-run
```

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--args VALUE` | replace the profile's raw args (repeat, one arg each; --args "" removes them) (repeatable) |
| `--billing VALUE` | plan or api |
| `--dry-run` | show the changes; write nothing |
| `--env VALUE` | set a literal variable NAME=value; NAME= removes it (repeat) (repeatable) |
| `--home VALUE` | move the profile to another home folder (the old one is kept) |
| `--home-login` | use the home's own login |
| `--id VALUE` | the profile |
| `--inherit-defaults` | use agents.<agent>.defaults.args first (the default) |
| `--login VALUE` | set the profile's login |
| `--no-inherit-defaults` | drop agents.<agent>.defaults.args for this profile |

### agx profile import

Write profiles for discovered homes; a plan unless --yes.

```sh
agx profile import --discovered
agx profile import --discovered --yes
agx profile import --id ~/.claude-acmecorp --name acmecorp --yes
```

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--agent VALUE` | only this agent's homes; decides the agent of an --id folder |
| `--discovered` | every discovered home that looks like a home and has no profile |
| `--id VALUE` | a home folder to import (repeat) (repeatable) |
| `--name VALUE` | the profile name (one --id only) |
| `--search VALUE` | also look in this folder and its sub-folders (repeat) (repeatable) |
| `--yes` | write the profiles (without it: the plan) |

### agx profile list

Every profile; --discovered lists homes found on this machine.

```sh
agx profile list
agx profile list --agent claude --plan
agx profile list --discovered --search ~/accounts
```

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--agent VALUE` | only this agent |
| `--discovered` | list agent homes found on this machine |
| `--plan` | add each home's plan (cost N) |
| `--profile VALUE`, `-p` | only these profiles (repeat) (repeatable) |
| `--search VALUE` | with --discovered: also look in this folder and its sub-folders (repeat) (repeatable) |

### agx profile remove

Remove a profile entry; the home is never deleted.

```sh
agx profile remove --id old
agx profile remove --id old --yes
```

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--id VALUE` | the profile |
| `--yes` | remove it (without it: the plan) |

agx profile show --id work

|---|---|
| `--id VALUE` | the profile |

### agx profile use

agx profile use --id work

|---|---|

### agx project

Folder bindings per agent.

### agx project list

Every binding, per agent.

### agx project remove

Remove a folder's binding for one agent or all.

```sh
agx project remove
agx project remove --dir ~/projects/client --agent codex
```

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--agent VALUE` | only this agent's binding (default: all) |
| `--dir VALUE` | the folder (default: the current folder) |

### agx project show

What a run here would do, every decision with its source.

```sh
agx project show
agx project show --dir ~/projects/client --agent codex
```

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--agent VALUE` | as run --agent |
| `--dir VALUE` | the folder (default: the current folder) |
| `--login VALUE` | as run --login |
| `--profile VALUE`, `-p` | as run --profile |

### agx project use

Bind a folder for one agent.

```sh
agx project use --profile work
agx project use --dir ~/projects/client --agent codex --login gem-work
agx project use --agent claude --home-login
```

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--agent VALUE` | the agent (needed with --login or --home-login alone) |
| `--dir VALUE` | the folder (default: the current folder) |
| `--home-login` | bind the home's own login |
| `--login VALUE` | bind this login |
| `--profile VALUE`, `-p` | bind this profile (its agent is the binding's agent) |

### agx resume

Continue a conversation on the home that stores it.

Continue a conversation in its own folder, on the home that stores it. Without --id or --last, a picker of this folder's chats (needs a terminal). The login is resolved as for agx run, with the binding of the chat's folder.

```sh
agx resume
agx resume --id 3f2a9c1e --login carol --dry-run
agx resume --last --scope all
agx resume --picker folder
```

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--add-dir VALUE` | extra folder the agent may access (repeat) (repeatable) |
| `--agent VALUE` | agent for the default or auto profile |
| `--auto-login` | pick the stored login with the most headroom (probes, cost Q) |
| `--autonomy VALUE` | default, read-only, ask, accept-edits or full |
| `--before-run VALUE` | a script to run first, for this run (relative to the current folder) |
| `--consent VALUE` | full-autonomy: allow --autonomy full |
| `--dry-run` | print every decision with its source; start nothing |
| `--env VALUE` | environment NAME=value; references expand strictly (repeat) (repeatable) |
| `--env-file VALUE` | a dotenv file, relative to the current folder (repeat) (repeatable) |
| `--headless` | machine-readable event stream |
| `--home-login` | the home's own login |
| `--id VALUE` | the conversation, exact or a unique prefix |
| `--last` | the newest chat, no picker |
| `--limit N` | conversations considered, newest first (0 = all) (default 50) |
| `--live-login` | switch this session's login while it runs (agx live use) |
| `--login VALUE` | a login name |
| `--model VALUE` | model |
| `--no-env VALUE` | remove this variable (repeat) (repeatable) |
| `--option VALUE` | typed agent launch option key=value (repeat) (repeatable) |
| `--picker VALUE` | chat or folder: pick a chat, or a folder then a chat (default chat) |
| `--pool-force VALUE` | on a pool login: every key of this run comes from this member, over the pool's rules |
| `--pool-only VALUE` | on a pool login: every key of this run comes from this member while its caps allow, else no key (never another member) |
| `--pool-only-short VALUE` | with --pool-only: a lower 5-hour cap for that member, for this run (never above its own) |
| `--pool-only-week VALUE` | with --pool-only: a lower weekly cap for that member, for this run (never above its own) |
| `--profile VALUE`, `-p` | the profile |
| `--prompt VALUE` | initial prompt |
| `--query VALUE` | narrow the list by title, folder or id |
| `--resolved-secrets` | with --dry-run: resolve references (cost X) and say resolved or why not |
| `--scope VALUE` | folder or all: this folder's chats, or every configured home's (default folder) |
| `--setting VALUE` | agent settings key=value; dotted keys nest (repeat) (repeatable) |
| `--settings-delivery VALUE` | file (default) or inline |
| `--token-kind VALUE` | kind of --token-ref: oauth-token, api-key or api-key-helper (default oauth-token) |
| `--token-ref VALUE` | a one-off token: a reference (${gopass:…}, $(…), ${VAR}) or a plain value |

### agx run

Start an agent here.

Start an agent in --dir or the current folder, on the resolved profile, home and login. Everything after -- goes to the agent untouched.

```sh
agx run --profile work
agx run --profile work --model opus --dry-run
agx run --agent codex -- --search
```

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--add-dir VALUE` | extra folder the agent may access (repeat) (repeatable) |
| `--agent VALUE` | agent for the default or auto profile |
| `--auto-login` | pick the stored login with the most headroom (probes, cost Q) |
| `--auto-profile` | pick the profile with the most headroom (cost N) |
| `--autonomy VALUE` | default, read-only, ask, accept-edits or full |
| `--before-run VALUE` | a script to run first, for this run (relative to the current folder) |
| `--consent VALUE` | full-autonomy: allow --autonomy full |
| `--dir VALUE` | start folder (default: the current folder) |
| `--dry-run` | print every decision with its source; start nothing |
| `--env VALUE` | environment NAME=value; references expand strictly (repeat) (repeatable) |
| `--env-file VALUE` | a dotenv file, relative to the current folder (repeat) (repeatable) |
| `--headless` | machine-readable event stream |
| `--home-login` | the home's own login |
| `--live-login` | switch this session's login while it runs (agx live use) |
| `--login VALUE` | a login name |
| `--model VALUE` | model |
| `--no-env VALUE` | remove this variable (repeat) (repeatable) |
| `--option VALUE` | typed agent launch option key=value (repeat) (repeatable) |
| `--pool-force VALUE` | on a pool login: every key of this run comes from this member, over the pool's rules |
| `--pool-only VALUE` | on a pool login: every key of this run comes from this member while its caps allow, else no key (never another member) |
| `--pool-only-short VALUE` | with --pool-only: a lower 5-hour cap for that member, for this run (never above its own) |
| `--pool-only-week VALUE` | with --pool-only: a lower weekly cap for that member, for this run (never above its own) |
| `--profile VALUE`, `-p` | the profile |
| `--prompt VALUE` | initial prompt |
| `--resolved-secrets` | with --dry-run: resolve references (cost X) and say resolved or why not |
| `--setting VALUE` | agent settings key=value; dotted keys nest (repeat) (repeatable) |
| `--settings-delivery VALUE` | file (default) or inline |
| `--token-kind VALUE` | kind of --token-ref: oauth-token, api-key or api-key-helper (default oauth-token) |
| `--token-ref VALUE` | a one-off token: a reference (${gopass:…}, $(…), ${VAR}) or a plain value |

### agx session

Session folders made by agx new.

### agx session clean

Remove empty session folders without history; a plan unless --yes.

```sh
agx session clean
agx session clean --min-age 72h --yes
```

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--min-age DURATION` | keep folders younger than this (default 24h0m0s) |
| `--yes` | remove the planned folders (without it: only the plan) |

### agx session list

Session folders with files and history.

### agx session promote

Move a session folder into a project with its history.

Move a session folder into <--to or sessions.promote_root>/<--name or its slug> with one rename, and re-key its history in every home whose agent can move history. An agent whose history cannot move (Codex) refuses the promote (exit 4) unless --no-codex, which leaves those conversations keyed to the old folder.

```sh
agx session promote --id pglite_golang_20261114_101500 --dry-run
agx session promote --id pglite_golang_20261114_101500 --name pglite --to ~/projects --git-repo
```

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | print the plan; change nothing |
| `--git-repo` | run git init in the promoted folder |
| `--id VALUE` | the session folder's name (agx session list) |
| `--name VALUE` | the project folder's name (default: the session's slug) |
| `--no-codex` | promote even though some history (Codex) cannot move with the folder |
| `--to VALUE` | the parent folder (default: sessions.promote_root) |

### agx shell-init

Print the shell layer.

Print the shell layer: one agx() wrapper that cds after new and resume and sets AGX_LOGIN for login use --terminal, plus one function per config alias. Evaluate it from the shell's startup file.

```sh
eval "$(agx shell-init --shell zsh)"        # ~/.zshrc (bash: ~/.bashrc)
agx shell-init --shell fish | source         # ~/.config/fish/config.fish
agx shell-init --shell pwsh | Out-String | Invoke-Expression   # $PROFILE
```

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--osc7` | report the current folder to the terminal (OSC 7) after the wrapper's cd |
| `--shell VALUE` | the shell: zsh, bash, fish, pwsh |

### agx skill

Print a Claude Code skill (SKILL.md) that teaches an agent every agx command; --install writes it.

Print a Claude Code skill: frontmatter (name agx and when to use it), how agx works (profiles, logins, pools, the resolution chain, --dry-run, --json and --field, exit codes), then every visible command with its descriptions and flags, generated from the command tree of this binary. --install writes it to ~/.claude/skills/agx/SKILL.md (folder 0755, file 0644), renaming an existing file to SKILL.md.bak-<timestamp> first; --dir chooses another skills folder, such as a project's .claude/skills.

```sh
agx skill | less
agx skill --install
agx skill --install --dir .claude/skills
```

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--dir VALUE` | the skills folder --install writes into (default ~/.claude/skills) |
| `--help`, `-h` | help for skill |
| `--install` | write the skill to <dir>/agx/SKILL.md instead of printing it (an existing file is backed up) |

### agx usage

Plan usage, one row per configured home.

Plan usage for every configured home, each home once with all its profiles. Live by default (one request per home; vendors may answer 429), --cached reads what the agent left on disk. The login flags probe stored logins, which spends a little of each plan. Exit 3 when some rows failed, 1 when none answered.

```sh
agx usage
agx usage --cached --agent claude
agx usage --all-logins --table --sort -left
agx usage --login personal --login derek --plan
```

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--agent VALUE` | only this agent |
| `--all-logins` | show every stored login instead of homes (cost Q) |
| `--cached` | disk readings only, no network (cost R); each row shows its age |
| `--duration-format VALUE` | how a reset a day or more away reads: truncate, round, minutes (default: config usage.duration_format, else truncate) |
| `--login VALUE` | show these logins instead of homes (repeat; cost Q) (repeatable) |
| `--login-picker` | tick logins in a checklist first (cost Q; terminal) |
| `--login-probes` | add one probed row per stored login (cost Q) |
| `--plan` | add plan, subscription status and start date |
| `--profile VALUE`, `-p` | only these profiles' homes (repeat) (repeatable) |
| `--sort VALUE` | order rows: login, left, 5h, 5h-reset, weekly, weekly-reset, day, status; - prefix for high to low; repeat for tie-breaks (repeatable) |
| `--table` | one compact row per home or login |
| `--time-format VALUE` | how reset times read: relative, day, absolute, both (default: config usage.time_format, else relative) |
| `--tz VALUE` | IANA zone for reset days and dates (default: this machine's) |

### agx version

Version, build provenance, components.

### agx whoami

Profile, login, home and run id of the current session.
